children: Meta (META) Q2 revenue $60.8B, +28% YoY; ad impressions +14%, ad prices +12%. Operating income $18.78B, down 8%; operating margin ~30.9%.
Analysts updated Meta (META) mid‑October: targets range $762–$1,000; forecasts cite AI, Muse Wonder, messaging monetization, and higher ad revenue projections relevant to traders.
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said Meta plans $100–$200B in investments, citing Prometheus and planned Hyperion AI clusters and potential revenue from premium subscriptions and AI tools for SMBs.
Meta (META) unveiled two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, and said it will report Q3 earnings after the close on October 21.
Meta Platforms (META) says it reached the AI frontier, won't slow development, assigns model safety to individual labs, and will keep investing in next-phase AI projects.
Guggenheim analyst Michael Morris raised Meta Platforms (META) 2027 capex forecast to $225B from $203B, reflecting a higher multi-year spending outlook relevant to traders.
UBS says Meta's ad performance is boosted by AI automation and recommendation systems this year, supporting upside for META's AI monetization; no specific revenue or unit figures were given.
Meta Platforms (META): Early Muse adoption links to higher daily active users. Company says Muse boosts engagement and supports ongoing monetization opportunities for the platform.
Meta Platforms Inc Class A (META) holds a 9.98% stake in Jio Platforms through its affiliate Jaadhu Holdings LLC, as disclosed in Jio Platforms' IPO prospectus.
Meta Platforms (META) is partnering with Reliance Intelligence, a Reliance Industries joint venture, to develop AI capabilities as part of Reliance’s push into AI and digital services.
